New York Times, Call It What It Is: A GENOCIDE! 🩸

Amnesty International and the most trusted humanitarian organizations in the world have declared Israel is committed gen•cide in Palestine. 

Israel systematically blocks humanitarian aid, kills children, targets hospitals, journalists, and aid workers, bombs “safe zones”, kidnaps and tortures civilians, and much more. 

Demand media accountability. Demand The New York Times calls this what it is, a Gen•cide. 

Take action: Unsubscribe from The New York Times, raise awareness of The NYT’s complicity in your social circle, and get your news from Palestinian journalists on the ground such as @alhelou.y2 and @anasjamal44 . 🇵🇸

📷 Protest on 5/28/25
